knowledge:
- key_parameters: dnacopy=DNAcopyParam(...) inside MinDistParam() controls the circular binary segmentation sensitivity (e.g., alpha, min.width) ;; nMAD in MinDistParam() sets the threshold in terms of median absolute deviations from zero for calling segments ;; state in FilterParamMD() specifies which of the 121 trio copy number states to filter for (e.g., "221" for de novo hemizygous deletion) ;; index_genome in CopyNumScanParams() maps the genomic marker names to the rows in the raw source files.
- alternatives: Two-step approach (calling CNVs in individuals first, then comparing) which is highly prone to false positives from technical variation like genomic waves ;; PennCNV joint HMM which also performs joint trio calling but may produce more false positives on non-HapMap experimental datasets compared to MinimumDistance.
- when_to_use: Use when you have high-dimensional genotyping array data (Illumina or Affymetrix) for case-parent trios and want to identify high-confidence de novo copy number variants while minimizing false positives from technical variation.
- pitfalls: Sample identifiers in the pedigree often differ from raw file names, requiring manual mapping and renaming of the ArrayViews columns ;; Nearby de novo segments might be artificially split by the segmentation algorithm, requiring a post-processing step of merging with reduce() and recalculating posterior probabilities with MAP2() ;; The genotypes function can be masked by other packages like crlmm, so it should be called explicitly via VanillaICE::genotypes().

workflows.name: trio_denovo_cnv_calling
workflows.intent: Identify, filter, and visualize de novo copy number variants in case-parent trios from raw genotyping report files.
input: FinalReport*.txt (raw genotyping report files for each family member)
sample_data.csv (sample metadata mapping file names to individual IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Create marker annotation and set sequence info ;; 2. Define ArrayViews to manage raw source files and parsed output directory ;; 3. Define parsing parameters and parse source files ;; 4. Define pedigree structure and map sample IDs ;; 5. Construct a MinDistExperiment object ;; 6. Segment the minimum distance and offspring log R ratios ;; 7. Calculate posterior probabilities and call trio states ;; 8. Filter called CNVs ;; 9. Merge adjacent segments and plot results
workflows.code:
library(oligoClasses)
library(VanillaICE)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(MinimumDistance)
foreach::registerDoSEQ()

library(data.table)
extdir <- system.file("extdata", package="VanillaICE")
features <- suppressWarnings(fread(file.path(extdir, "SNP_info.csv")))
fgr <- GRanges(paste0("chr", features$Chr), IRanges(features$Position, width=1),
               isSnp=features[["Intensity Only"]]==0)
fgr <- SnpGRanges(fgr)
names(fgr) <- features[["Name"]]

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18)
sl <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18)
seqlevels(fgr) <- sl[sl %in% seqlevels(fgr)]
seqinfo(fgr) <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18)[seqlevels(fgr),]
fgr <- sort(fgr)

files <- list.files(extdir, full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE, pattern="FinalReport")

parsedDir <- "ParsedFiles"
if(!file.exists(parsedDir)) dir.create(parsedDir)
views <- ArrayViews(rowRanges=fgr, sourcePaths=files, parsedPath=parsedDir)

dat <- fread(files[1], skip="[Data]")

select_columns <- match(c("SNP Name", "Allele1 - AB", "Allele2 - AB",
                          "Log R Ratio", "B Allele Freq"), names(dat))

index_genome <- match(names(fgr), dat[["SNP Name"]])

scan_params <- CopyNumScanParams(index_genome=index_genome,
                                 select=select_columns,
                                 cnvar="Log R Ratio",
                                 bafvar="B Allele Freq",
                                 gtvar=c("Allele1 - AB", "Allele2 - AB"))

parseSourceFile(views[, 1], scan_params)
invisible(sapply(views, parseSourceFile, param=scan_params))

ped_list <- ParentOffspringList(pedigrees=list(
                                  ParentOffspring(id = "hapmap", father="12287_03",
                                                  mother="12287_02",
                                                  offspring="12287_01",
                                                  parsedPath=parsedPath(views)),
                                  ParentOffspring(id = "cleft",
                                                  father="22169_03",
                                                  mother="22169_02",
                                                  offspring="22169_01",
                                                  parsedPath=parsedPath(views))))

sample_info <- read.csv(file.path(extdir, "sample_data.csv"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
ind_id <- setNames(gsub(" ", "", sample_info$IndividualID), sample_info$File)
colnames(views) <- ind_id[gsub(".txt", "", colnames(views))]

me <- MinDistExperiment(views, pedigree=ped_list[[2]])

segment_params <- DNAcopyParam(alpha=0.01)
params <- MinDistParam(dnacopy=segment_params)

mdgr <- segment2(me, params)
md_g <- MAP2(me, mdgr, params)

filter_param <- FilterParamMD()
cnvFilter(md_g, filter_param)

denovoHemizygous(md_g)
denovoHomozygous(md_g)

select_cnv <- FilterParamMD(state=c("220", "221", "223"), seqnames="chr22")
cnvs <- cnvFilter(md_g, select_cnv)

library(grid)
g2 <- reduce(denovoHemizygous(md_g), min.gapwidth=500e3)
post <- MAP2(me, g2, params)
g2 <- denovoHemizygous(post)
vps <- pedigreeViewports()
grid.params <-  HmmTrellisParam()
p <- plotDenovo(me, g2, grid.params)
pedigreeGrid(g=g2, vps=vps, figs=p)
